title: Reconstructing the Clebsch code and its golden orientation from its deep-hole syndrome locus
description: This preprint proves that the projective deep-hole syndrome locus characterizes the Clebsch code and reconstructs its conic, polarity, symmetry, and intrinsic golden orientation two-graph. The repository also contains a computational companion with exact finite-field censuses, a q=13 tangent-code theorem, decoding checks, and independently replayable terminal exclusions.
